✦ Insights — Ashford Supply Co.Copy · 👍 👎
Visual patterns — what's working

Top performers lean into clean, solo-product studio shots and rugged outdoor lifestyle:

[Ad 18] The weekender on pure white, product-only, no model. $76 spend / 37.1x ROAS. Catalog-style clarity.

[Ad 3] Suede weekender, centered on white, serif framing. $284 spend / 24.9x ROAS — the strongest scaled winner.

[Ad 8] Lifestyle: product in-hand on a windswept coast. $177 spend / 24.5x ROAS. Product in motion.

Pattern: white-background solo-product shots convert hardest per dollar, while lifestyle works when the product is clearly in-hand.

Personas being targeted

Persona 1 — the weekend traveler. Classic interiors, tailoring, the holdall packed for a trip.

Persona 2 — the outdoors buyer. 4x4, moorland, weathered outerwear. The dominant thread — 9 of 20 ads.

Persona 3 — the craft purist. Pure product study on white, no scene.

Creative recommendations

1. Retire the car-interior shot (Ad 1) — it's absorbed $1,176 at sub-1.7x ROAS. 2. Scale the white-background format — expect ~3 conv per $284 at the 24.9x pattern. 3. Re-cut the suede video to open on the bag, not the seat.
